name: Mia Linden
source:
[i]"Honestly, you're useless without me!"[/i]

The heroine's best friend. She has a bright and optimistic personality, is a big fan of Cyril, and goes cafe-hopping for fun. Due to an accident when she was young, her left leg has been fitted with cybertech.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=mia]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
